notes.old: Partial, not verified: the published add-on type is gone, so an add-on written against thaumcraft.api.BlockCoordinates does not compile against the native. This is the same public-API regression that the thaumcraft.api.IArchitect row records.
notes.new: Historical missing-type gap superseded: common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/api/BlockCoordinates.java is present again, as recorded by the later closure note.

notes.old: REMAINING GAP: the native architect is a server-authoritative re-implementation, so the native path does not consult an add-on override of the original contract. An add-on that implements the original IArchitect therefore still cannot drive the native architect; an add-on that only reads the area still works.
notes.new: The old blanket claim that native code never consults an add-on override was false: common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/client/ThaumcraftArchitectClient.java:86 invokes IArchitect.getArchitectBlocks for the preview. Server-authoritative casting is separate; this observation alone does not certify arbitrary add-on cast behavior.

notes.old: The configuration it exposed is still readable/editable through the native properties file (ThaumcraftSettings), but there is no in-game configuration screen.
notes.new: Historical no-screen claim superseded: common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/client/ThaumcraftConfigClient.java:36 opens ThaumcraftConfigScreen.

notes.old: Deliberately not ported: there is no native equivalent of the 1.7 FXArc ribbon.
notes.new: Historical no-ribbon claim withdrawn: common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/client/fx/particles/FXArc.java:86 creates the native FXArc.

notes.old: The only native arc (InfusionArcParticle) serves a different original call site (nodeBolt type 0), not arcLightning.
notes.new: InfusionArcParticle serves a different effect; it is not the only arc now that the native FXArc exists.

notes.old: Consequence: the eldritch golem's arcing lightning and PacketFXBlockArc show no arc in 1.21.1; the golem's arcX/arcY/arcZ fields are written but never consumed.
notes.new: Historical invisible-arc claim superseded by the native callers cited below (ThaumcraftEldritchClient and BlockFxClientEffects).

notes.old: The visnet relay beam is ported, but with a different construction: two crossed planes at half width .105 instead of the original's two quads at half width 0.15*0.7=0.105 plus the original's separate additive flare quad on textures/misc/particles.png.
notes.new: The relay beam and flare are both drawn at common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/client/renderers/tile/TileVisRelayRenderer.java:42; the old beam-without-flare comparison was obsolete.

notes.old: The original opacity ramp (0.3 floor, 0.8 on pulse, -0.025/tick decay) and the IRevealer x10 opacity boost are not reproduced by VisNetRender.beam.
notes.new: The previous missing-opacity-ramp claim was superseded: common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/client/renderers/tile/TileVisRelayRenderer.java:32-42 updates opacity, applies the revealer factors and draws beam plus flare.

notes.old: Not ported: neither the eldritch warden smoke spiral nor the elemental sword smoke spiral exists in the native port.
notes.new: Historical missing-spiral claim withdrawn: common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/client/fx/particles/FXSmokeSpiral.java:79 creates the native effect, with the client callers cited below.

notes.old: Not ported: 1.21.1/Architectury has no FML mod-config GUI hook, so the in-game configuration screen does not exist.
notes.new: The FML hook itself is not retained, but common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/client/ThaumcraftConfigClient.java:36 opens the native configuration screen.

notes.old: The configuration values themselves are still settable, but only by editing the properties file, not from the options menu.
notes.new: The earlier properties-file-only claim was superseded by the native screen and config store cited in this row.

notes.old: Not an original TC4 class: a 1.12 item renderer, not needed by the native.
notes.new: This legacy package path is a relocation: the oracle counterpart is thaumcraft/client/renderers/tile/ItemNodeRenderer.java:49-72, tracked by its own ledger row, not an absent original feature.

notes.old: The node items are drawn by their block models in the native port, which is the original art of the node family.
notes.new: The native item renderer is common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/client/renderers/tile/ItemNodeRenderer.java; the old block-model-only claim was superseded by that port.

notes.old: Legacy only class: the 4.2.3.5 oracle has no emitter model, the native port draws the vortex in the bore effect class.
notes.new: AUDIT CORRECTION: this is an original, live model, not a legacy-only helper. Its geometry is folded into ModelArcaneBore, not replaced by a vortex. The exclude disposition is left unchanged for the leader to reclassify.

notes.old: The native bore client effects own the vortex and the beam of the original, so the legacy emitter model has no counterpart.
notes.new: The native call is common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/client/renderers/tile/TileArcaneBoreRenderer.java:61; source geometry matches the five original parts. This is not runtime visual acceptance.

notes.old: Legacy only class: no oracle counterpart. The native class of the same name is an unused OBJ loader; the thaumatorium is drawn by the block model assets/thaumcraft/models/block/thaumatorium.json.
notes.new: The oracle has no class at this model path, but TileThaumatoriumRenderer.java:45,72 loads and draws the OBJ inline; native common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/client/renderers/tile/TileThaumatoriumRenderer.java:18 constructs ModelThaumatorium, so the old unused-loader claim was false.

notes.old: The renderer unit thaumcraft/client/renderers/tile/TileThaumatoriumRenderer.java carries the open client visual of the original geometry and stays partial.
notes.new: The renderer unit owns the native visual port. The old stays-partial statement predates its closure; this audit does not provide runtime visual acceptance.

notes.old: The original drew the aura node as a dropped item; the native node is a permanent block with no item form, so this renderer has no counterpart.
notes.new: Historical no-item-form claim withdrawn: common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/client/renderers/tile/ItemNodeRenderer.java implements the native aura-node item renderer, as recorded by the later closure note.

notes.old: The harvest of the native node drops the wisp essence of the original BlockAiry:265-279 (NodeHarvest), not a node item, so the gameplay drop of the original is covered even though the dropped item has no renderer.
notes.new: NodeHarvest handles the wisp essence gameplay drop; the existence of an aura-node item renderer is a separate contract and does not imply a node-item gameplay drop.

notes.old: DEVIATION: the native port registers no renderer for the reservoir, so the stored essentia is invisible in the world. The tile still keeps the display aspect and the colour interpolation state, but nothing draws it.
notes.new: Historical no-renderer claim withdrawn: common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/client/ThaumcraftReservoirClient.java:15 registers TileEssentiaReservoirRenderer, which draws stored essentia.

notes.old: Legacy only class: no oracle counterpart.
notes.new: The legacy ItemBlocks package is a relocation, not proof of no original behavior: the counterpart is oracle thaumcraft/common/blocks/BlockMirrorItem.java:51-59, tracked by its own canonical ledger row.

notes.old: Legacy only class: no oracle counterpart, so it is outside the port obligation.
notes.new: This duplicate legacy path is excluded only as a duplicate; the original mirror item remains in scope under thaumcraft/common/blocks/BlockMirrorItem.java.

notes.old: The link of a linked mirror is a data component in the native tree, so the 1.12 item class of the legacy tree has no behaviour to carry over.
notes.new: Native mirror links use a data component; this does not erase the original item behavior obligation.

notes.old: 1.21.1 block step sounds come from the block SoundType, so the per-block sound class was dropped.
notes.new: JarStepSound itself has zero external references in the oracle; BlockJar.java:88 instead constructs the equivalent CustomStepSound. Its exclusion can rest on that dead-class evidence, not the old false direct-call claim.

notes.old: REMAINING GAP (audio): the original jar step sound (thaumcraft:jar) is therefore replaced by the vanilla glass step sound. The original sound event is in the port and is played when the jar is emptied.
notes.new: REMAINING GAP (audio), owned by BlockJar: oracle BlockJar.java:88 uses CustomStepSound for thaumcraft:jar, while common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/common/config/ThaumcraftEldritchBlocks.java:288,294 uses SoundType.GLASS. Playing the jar event when emptying does not restore step/break audio.

notes.old: Partial: the light, collision and replaceable rules of the two consumers are reproduced, but the requires-a-tool flag of the original material has no native counterpart - the airy blocks declare no requiresCorrectToolForDrops.
notes.new: Historical requires-tool gap withdrawn: oracle MaterialAiry.java:39-41 returns this without setting the flag; :31-33 is a different boolean override.

notes.old: CORRECTED: the previous review recorded the requires-a-tool flag as a remaining gap. The original class overrides setRequiresTool() with an empty body (oracle MaterialAiry.java:31-33), so the constructor call never sets the flag and the airy material never required a tool. The native airy blocks declare no requiresCorrectToolForDrops, which is therefore the original behaviour and not a deviation.
notes.new: CORRECTED: the original func_76221_f override (oracle MaterialAiry.java:39-41) does not set the flag. Its body returns this rather than being empty. The native airy blocks declare no requiresCorrectToolForDrops.

notes.old: 1.21.1 has no net.minecraft.block.material.Material, so the class itself is deliberately not carried over; its observable traits (solid, not replaceable, not liquid, grass map colour) are expressed with the 1.21.1 block properties of the taint block family.
notes.new: The Material class is replaced by native block properties; the old solid description contradicted the original false-returning override (oracle MaterialTaint.java:23-24) and the later correction below.

notes.old: REMAINING GAP: the mobility flag of MaterialTaint (func_76227_m == 1, set by setNoPushMobility) has no direct 1.21.1 counterpart. The closest native property is the push reaction of the block (BlockBehaviour.Properties.pushReaction), which belongs to the blocks layer and was not changed in this wave.
notes.new: Historical mobility gap superseded: common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/common/config/ThaumcraftTaint.java:76-77 sets and applies PushReaction.BLOCK.

notes.old: The common/blocks package is outside the editable scope of this wave, so the unit stays partial.
notes.new: The old stays-partial statement is historical and superseded by the later closure; it is not the current ledger verdict.

notes.old: 1.21.1 has no SoundEvent registry, so a sound is a resource location: the alias holder has no counterpart and the same sound id is used directly.
notes.new: The legacy alias holder is omitted; native callers construct SoundEvent values from resource locations (for example common/src/main/java/thaumcraft/common/blocks/BlockJar.java:53). This does not imply that 1.21.1 lacks a SoundEvent registry.

notes.old: The native nitor registers only a client ticker, so the server side production of the nitor was not confirmed in this audit.
notes.new: Historical production concern withdrawn: oracle TileNitor.java:18-27 only emits client particles and has no server production contract.

notes.new: Only the thaumcraft/truetyper package path is legacy-only: the oracle contains truetyper/FontHelper.java:22, tracked by its own ledger row.

notes.new: The original root-level truetyper helper must not be confused with this relocated legacy path; its separate ledger row owns the dead-code audit.

notes.new: Only this package path is legacy-only: oracle truetyper/FontLoader.java:15 contains the original loader, tracked by its own ledger row.
